comparison: Unmodified English cartridge ROMs. Later official animations and donor patches were compared in source.
method: Start a fresh game in memory. Seed a disposable party and wild opponent. Play both sides through the normal battle command loop with controlled move slots. Read the Defense stage, battle flags, loaded picture tiles, and rendered pixels.
return_path_method: Use normal battle menu input in the controlled stock-ROM fixture. For STATS, measure picture tile bytes and rendered pixels after closing the party menu and after a later sprite draw. Also run a case with a draw of the blank tiles before STATS. Measure Defense stage, picture bytes, and the active Substitute and Minimize flags.
